attackFamilies.label: Word substitution
attackFamilies.detail: Ranks influential words and searches constrained replacements, similar to a TextFooler-style black-box attack.

attackFamilies.label: Paraphrase search
attackFamilies.detail: Searches sentence-level rewrites. It covers broader language variation but needs stronger meaning validation.

attackFamilies.label: Adaptive composite
attackFamilies.detail: Combines encodings, lexical edits, and paraphrases after observing prior model responses.
